filter: Only entries with cipher_suite == 1 (MLS_128_DHKEMX25519_AES128GCM_SHA256_Ed25519, the mandatory-to-implement suite this crate pins) are vendored. Untouched otherwise; entries with redaction placeholders were counted and there are none in the vendored subsets.
usage: Consumed by crypto/mls-wasm (native cargo test and wasm-bindgen export) and scripts/run-mls-vectors.mjs. These are read-only inputs; regenerate the filter with the documented count/sha256 values, never edit by hand.

messages.json.filterNote: messages.json upstream has no cipher_suite field; entries were selected by the ciphersuite u16 inside the serialized mls_key_package (offset after version u16 + MlsMessageBodyIn discriminant u16), verified == 1 for all 100 kept and != 1 (2 or 3) for all 200 dropped.
